Strategy: Scale the winning band reward and penalty with the item size, so larger items earn bigger bonuses and penalties than smaller ones. It may help by matching the reward to the item scale, but may fail if fixed rewards were already the right size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
